formula: triangle: Delta_q N / 8; box: Delta_q^2 N / 192; massive rank<=4 pentagon: zero by superficial UV degree<=-2, four-dimensional +--- signature
normalization_derivation: oneloopmaster A00 pole is (m^2)^2/4; two mass-squared derivatives divided by2! give1/4 per triangle metric, contracting N to Delta_q N/2. A0000 pole is (m^2)^3/24; three mass-squared derivatives divided by 3! give 1/24 for a box metric pairing. The quartic numerator contracts the three pairings to Delta_q^2 N/8. The supplied overall factor is applied exactly once.
preconditions: The shared DOT preparation extracts one physical propagator per internal edge, rejects repeated/nonquadratic loop denominators, and returns normalized unit-power quadratic denominators. The Rust probe separately verifies every squared mass is173^2=29929, no explicit mu2, a loop-independent prefactor and the polynomial rank<=2 for triangles and<=4 for boxes/pentagons.
scope: Independent per-graph single-pole control and exact fifty-graph UV cancellation; finite parts and reduction coefficients are not tested here.
input_precision_note: Exact fixture inputs are differentiated and evaluated at 256 bits. MadLoop input wavefunctions/couplings are binary64, also in fixed mode4. This is not an independent high-precision physical-input oracle.
analytic_controls: massive rank<=4 pentagon: superficial UV degree<=-2 -> 0
